method: breaths by loudness (under -14 dB for 0.4 s, phrases under 1.5 s merged) + text alignment; Whisper: 11 of 11 breaks heard

lines.latin: nostras deprecatiónes ne despícias in necessitátibus:
lines.english: despise not our petitions in our necessities,

lines.latin: sed a perículis cunctis líbera nos semper, Virgo gloriósa et benedícta.
lines.english: but deliver us always from all dangers, O glorious and blessed Virgin.

lines.latin: Ora pro nobis, sancta Dei Génitrix.
lines.english: Pray for us, O holy Mother of God.
That we may be made worthy of the promises of Christ.

lines.latin: Concéde nos fámulos tuos, quǽsumus Dómine Deus, perpétua mentis et córporis sanitáte gaudére:
lines.english: Grant, we beseech Thee, O Lord God, unto us Thy servants, that we may rejoice in continual health of mind and body,

lines.latin: et gloriósa beátæ Maríæ semper Vírginis intercessióne,
lines.english: and by the glorious intercession of Blessed Mary, ever virgin,

lines.latin: a præsénti liberári tristítia, et ætérna pérfrui lætítia.
lines.english: may be delivered from present sadness, and enter into the joy of Thine eternal gladness.
